approval.confirmation_reference: The user instructed uninterrupted best-plan execution and the formal slot attribution pre-registered this minimal next readiness.
approval.scope: One immutable C01 real-batch endpoint relation metric readiness; no training, C07 model forward, C08 or graph.

corrective_scope: V1 failed only because a paper-figure histogram treated anchor norm >=80 m as invalid. V1R preserves every numeric target and all scientific gates, records the true maximum, and counts values beyond the 80 m display range in an explicit overflow bin.

estimated_cost.compute: One deterministic CUDA forward/backward, permutation/yaw/repeat probes and complete-link decode.

failure_policy: Any gradient, permutation, yaw, symmetry, deterministic clustering, source hash, environment, resource or leakage failure stops. Readiness makes no accuracy claim and cannot open C08 or graph.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.clustering: One-threshold complete-link decode is deterministic and unit tests refuse chain merges.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.gradient: All four losses finite; every head tensor has finite nonzero gradient; all backbone gradients absent and state unchanged.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.invariance: Repeat bit-exact; primitive permutation and sensor-yaw errors <=3e-5; pair score exact symmetric.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.model: 426818 trainable head parameters/34 tensors and 2635631 frozen backbone parameters; O(E) endpoint embeddings and symmetric O(E^2) metric only at scoring.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.population: Exact fit/C07 manifests 426552/64644; fixed batch128 contains nonempty clique, dustbin and overlap supervision; zero C07/C08 forward.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.resources: CUDA allocated/reserved/process <=16 GiB and host RSS <=4 GiB.

purpose: Zero-training real-batch proof that a no-arbitrary-slot endpoint embedding can receive same-composition/different/overlap gradients and decode one-threshold complete-link clusters without Teacher data in forward.
retention: Keep test log, real-batch losses/gradients/contracts, implementation figure PNG/PDF/SVG, environment, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

sampling.independent_sampling_units: One fixed C01 topology/geometry task and 128 five-frame sequences; implementation probe only, not an accuracy estimate.
sampling.rule: Read rows 0:128 from the sealed S01_flat_tree_small_C01__c1_mixed fit task exactly once; inspect only C07 manifest counts and perform zero C07 forward.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project-generated Cano assets; redistribution remains subject to upstream licensing.
raw_sources: sealed P1a corrected C01--C07 sensor pose and construction-program primitive endpoints
sealed P1b C01--C07 five-frame cropped primitive axes and endpoint-neighbor labels
sealed V2 relation failure attribution establishing zero safe true attachment for all three seeds

split.fit: Only the fixed C01 batch may be loaded for forward/backward implementation checks.
split.historical_pollution_audit: The architecture and all contracts were written after formal slot attribution but before any endpoint-metric training or C07 inference.
split.selection: C07 arrays are not loaded; only sealed manifest counts are checked.

teacher.labels: Same-clique pair positives; different-clique, singleton dustbin and disconnected-overlap negatives.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: A future accepted cluster proposes a local relation only; graph edges still require physical traversal.
teacher.source: Sealed construction composition cliques and endpoint observability for one C01 batch.
teacher.student_forbidden_inputs: Teacher labels, world/node/primitive identity, absolute pose, future frames and C07+ never enter forward.

teacher_source: One fixed 128-row C01 fit batch from sealed P1a/P1b/observability. Construction clique labels and overlap negatives are used only after forward to evaluate losses.
